description:
Trimming team bios to fit the character limit.

404 Gravity Not Found 🚀: four high school students passionate about STEM, space and challenges. Lía (Team Leader) keeps us organized and learns Mandarin. Lucas (Programmer) turns ideas into code. Rafa (Electronics & Ideas) competes in OMAPA, the Paraguayan Math Olympiad. Katherine (Chemistry) won silver at CoNaQ, the National Chemistry Olympiad. We want to build an original, fun game. Looking for: artists, designers, sound creators and storytellers. Curiosity matters most!
